$comment: Desired state of the production Fly app's launch flags and the secrets copied from GitHub, applied ONLY by .github/workflows/fly-env-sync.yml (plan -> apply -> verify). Runbook: docs/runbooks/launch-flags.md.

flags: each value is "unset" (the name must not exist on Fly; the code default applies) or one value from that name's closed set (ENV_RULES `values` in src/common/env-validation.ts). Flag values are not secret.

secrets: "github-secret" (Fly must hold the GitHub Actions secret of the same name, which must be set and non-empty), "present" (must exist on Fly; its value is owned by another workflow and never written here) or "unset" (must not exist on Fly).
One entry per line, so every flip is a one-line diff. Every flip is its own audited PR; merging a PR changes nothing until the operator dispatches the workflow in apply mode.
gates: why each name has its current value and what must be true before it flips. excluded: registered names this manifest deliberately does not manage, with the reason.
test/ci/fly-env-manifest.spec.ts validates this file against ENV_RULES, the preconditions in scripts/fly-env/fly-env-manifest.js and the workflow's env block.

gates.BILLING_ENFORCEMENT: Launch posture, not a feature flag: docs/deploy-runbook.md step 3.2 says this stays unset (observe-only) during the Stripe rollout and flips to "enforce" only after every coach has a CoachSubscription row in "active" state. The production machine currently HAS it set (read-only Fly Env Truth run 37559943231, registered + present + non-empty), left over from the 2026-04-30 fly-secrets-set run, while production holds exactly one CoachSubscription row on tier "free" and nothing sells the pro tier yet. In enforce mode SubscriptionGuard denies every @RequiresTier('pro') route with 403 TIER_UPGRADE_REQUIRED for any non-owner coach: /coach/ai/* (coach AI drafts, approve, edit, reject), /v1/coach/ai/draft/* (assign workout, assign meal plan) and /workout-programs/* (fork, clone, clone-to-client, program assignments). Declaring it unset here restores the documented launch posture; denies are still computed and logged as telemetry. Flip back to "enforce" after the pro upgrade path ships and every coach has an active row.
